summary: fabric-asset-pipeline exfiltrates Minecraft launcher tokens and host identity to a Discord webhook on install
details: The package's postinstall runs index.js, which reads Minecraft launcher account files across multiple launchers (Mojang launcher_accounts.json, Prism/MultiMC, TLauncher, Modrinth, PolyMC, GDLauncher) plus a temp session dump, extracts accessToken, username and UUID, and POSTs them together with os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, os.platform() and os.release() to a hardcoded Discord webhook at discord.com/api/webhooks/1554065488726990909/... The webhook URL is stored as a base64 literal in index.js and decoded at runtime via Buffer.from(..., "base64").toString() to conceal the destination. The stated package purpose ("Fabric asset loader bridge") is unrelated to the launcher credential paths being read. The account access tokens permit session takeover of the affected Minecraft accounts on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
